title: FIG. 01 · The Room
summary: The founder's own hero, set harder. A warm frosted room is lit from the right, where three people at work read clearly as silhouettes in cols 7–12. A 116px two-voice statement stacks down the left in tracked-caps Kelwin grammar. The film is credited as FIG. 01, with a Close | Wide control and a real 'Pause film'. This replaces today's dune photo and HUD panel.

reference.borrowed: Grok's corner-anchored composition. A near-black field is lit by one warm source bleeding in from the right edge, which leaves the left ~55% dark for a two-tone headline under a small caps label. The middle stays empty, and the UI is pinned to the corners: tracked caps nav plus an outlined action top-right, a cue bottom-left, the action pair bottom-right.
reference.kelwin: The light source becomes FIG. 01, the warm frosted film (blur 8px, frost .20). It is cropped height-fit to the right half of the room, so a man seen from behind, a standing colleague bent over the table and a seated one gather in cols 6–12. A left-to-right scrim inside .km-film hides the plate's mirrored half under the type. Grok's grey-to-bright headline becomes the 116px Mona wide H1: 'Revenue is / an architectural' at weight 430 in --fg, then 'problem.' at weight 300 in --fg-2, tracked −0.018em. The bracketed label becomes '■ GTM SYSTEMS PARTNER' in Mona 500 caps tracked .18em. The pill becomes the square outlined 'AUDIT REQUEST ↗', beside a tracked-caps nav with no dot separators and a margin-to-margin hairline. Under the statement sit a 48×2 red rule, the 20px lede and the two doors in tracked caps: the 56px red 'REQUEST A SYSTEM AUDIT ↗' and an underlined 'TALK TO THE TEAM →'. The corner action pair becomes the bottom-right '■ A FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC' note. The bottom corners become a FIG. band under a hairline: 'FIG. 01 · THE ROOM WHERE PIPELINE IS DECIDED' at left, and at right a CLOSE | WIDE segmented control plus 'PAUSE FILM', whose bottom edge is a 1px progress hairline. There are no brackets and no HUD readouts. Red appears only on the CTA, the rule and the two label squares.

motion: entrance (≤1.6s, --ease-out): the film fades up from graphite on the Close crop (1.2s) while the nav hairline draws left→right. The red-square label fades in (300ms). The H1 lines rise out of masks (800ms, 120ms stagger), and the light 'problem.' lands 200ms after the medium lines. The 48px red rule draws, then the lede, the two doors and the audit note fade up 12px (600ms). The FIG. band hairline draws margin to margin, and the caption and controls fade in.

orchestrated moment: at 2.4s the figure advances its state once. The segmented control flips Close → Wide, and the camera pulls back over 1.6s --ease-inout (scale + translate on the film plate), revealing the three people behind the statement.
ambient: only the film loops: the base 32s drift, a silhouette crossing, and the frosted-glass grain. The 1px progress hairline on the PAUSE FILM control fills over the same 32s. Nothing else loops.

interaction: CLOSE | WIDE reframes the film (1.6s ease-inout). 'PAUSE FILM' really pauses the drift, the walker, the grain and the progress hairline, and flips to 'PLAY FILM'. On CTA hover the fill deepens to --accent-hover and ↗ moves 2px up-right. On the secondary, the underline turns --fg and → nudges 3px. Nav items lift from --fg-2 to --fg, and the outlined nav action's border goes to --fg.
on the live site: the plate is the background <video>, and the pull-back runs once on load. Reduced motion shows the Wide resting frame with no entrance.
notes: Critique pass. The founder's latest layout and type spec overrides direction A's Plurel-style nav and buttons, so the dot-separated sentence-case nav and sentence-case buttons are now tracked caps (Mona 500, --label-tracking). Labels are Mona 500 caps, and the H1 uses --display-tracking (−0.018em). The H1 is 116px, not 120: at 120px with the spec tracking, 'an architectural' overran col 8 (x 931) and was clipped by its rise mask. Film calibration: blur 8px, frost .20, brightness 1.2 (the brief's 20px is above the 8–12px cap; 8px keeps the heads and shoulders legible), and the plate is lowered ~6% so the man seen from behind clears the nav scrim. The same calibration is used by the nav and interior films. The plate is height-fit (background-size auto 100%, offset −334px), so the three figures read as heads and shoulders at full size, and the scrim keeps the mirrored half of the plate out of sight. Arrows are drawn as 1.5px inline SVG because the brand fonts carry no ↗ or → glyphs. The stage is ~986px tall: 96 nav + body + 88 FIG. band. Labels are 11px (the founder's small-label spec).
